text: Let us recap. Natural processes run one way, and no real process is reversible. Kelvin Planck forbids a perfect engine, and Clausius forbids a fridge that needs no power. An engine's efficiency is one minus Q two over Q one. The Otto cycle gives one minus one over r to the gamma minus one, and the diesel cycle allows a bigger r. The Carnot efficiency, one minus T two over T one, is the maximum possible. A refrigerator's coefficient of performance is Q two over W. And entropy, d Q over T, never decreases for the universe as a whole.
